promises.label: FY26 revenue growth guidance raised
promises.quote: The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY26 operating margin guidance
promises.quote: Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: 20,000 campus hires this year
promises.quote: We will do 20,000 campus hires and we will continue in that sort of a range for next year

promises.label: Investor Day this quarter
promises.quote: We will share a comprehensive view on our approach at an Investor Day later this quarter.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: Labor code ongoing impact 15 bps annually
promises.quote: There will be an ongoing impact of roughly around 15 basis points. That will happen on an annual basis.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: FY27 acceleration in Financial Services and EURS
promises.quote: In Financial services and in Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services verticals, we expect acceleration in financial year 2027 over financial year 2026.
